tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /snang srid dregs pa'i ded dpon mthu bo che sogs// swau/ snang srid dregs pa'i ded dpon mthu bo che/ /kun khyab rdo rje drag rtsal 'khor bcas la/ /'khrul zad rje btsun gong mas stsal ba yi/ /mdo sde lha mchod dus ston 'char can dang / /dbang phyug me glang gsar tshes lung phebs su/ /khyed sku mdzes pa'i dbu chings na bza' la/ /rten 'brel ri mos bkra ba srings shig ces/ /bka' stsal ji bzhin 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/ /dbu thod phyi nang dmar ba'i mdangs ldan 'dis/ /dbang drag rol pa'i dge mtshan gsal bar mdzod/ /sna tshogs rdo rje'i ri mo bkod pa 'dis/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i bka' dam ji bzhin du/ /rnam bzhi'i 'phrin las 'bad med lhun grub mdzod/ /lha rdzas na bza' dbang gi mdangs ldan 'dis/ /thugs rjes sems can don la rjes chags mdzod/ /'byung chen rnam bzhi'i ri mo ngo mtshar 'dis/ /snod kyi 'jig rten phun tshogs rgyas par mdzod/ /nyan thos brtul zhugs bzung ba'i rnam 'gyur 'dis/ /sde snod gsum gyi bstan pa rgyas par mdzod/ /sngags 'chang 'jigs med bdud dpung zil gnon 'dis/ /rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa rgyas par mdzod/ /dpa' bo brjid pa'i cha lugs 'dzin pa 'dis/ /bod yul skyes pa'i tshe dpal rgyas par mdzod/ /mdzes ma dar dang rin chen brgyan pa 'dis/ /bud med rnams kyi dbu dpal rgyas par mdzod/ /dzo ki snod bcud phun tshogs thogs pa 'dis/ /'gal rkyen sel zhing mthun rkyen 'grub par mdzod/ /yal ga'i bu chung ro bzang myong ba 'dis/ /rnam shes spre'us yang dag don mthong mdzod/ /rgyab mdun gnyis su lcags mdung bsgrengs ba 'dis/ /dam chos sgrub kun tshe srog sra bar mdzod/ /de la mdzes pa'i rgyan gyis dpa' ba 'dis/ /rnam 'dren kun gyi phrin las rgyas par mdzod/ /dpung bskor gnyis la nyi zla gsal ba 'dis/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa de lta'i 'od bzhin mdzod/

/sngon tshe brtse ldan mkhan slob chos gsum dang / /phyi rabs sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po yis/ /snyigs dus bod yul bstan 'gro srungs shigs ces/ /bka' bsgos ji bzhin khyed kyis zhal bzhes ltar/ /nyin mtshan bsrung skyob bya ra mel tshe mdzod/ khyad par 'khon rigs bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /lo 'dir 'gal rkyen bar chad yod min dang / /nu bo rgyan mchog shin tu bro 'tshal bas/ /de la phan pa'i phrin las myur sgrub cing / /sman bcos rim gro so skyes ma shes kun/ /srung ma khyed kyis dwangs gsal bsgribs med stsol/ /gangs khrod 'di na ngan 'bras dar ba'i mthus/ /kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i dbang po dag zhing gshegs/ /chos dang srid kyi dge legs dman pa'i dus/ /tse'u dmar khyed kyis 'phrin las mi sgrub na/ /sngon tshe slob dpon padma 'byung gnas sogs/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i bka' bsgo dam bzhag dang / /khyed kyi thugs bskyed smon lam rdzogs lags sam/ /de phyir khas blangs dam bcas ma g.yel bar/ /shākya'i bstan pa yun du gnas pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang skal bzang rgya mtsho yi/ /mchog gi sprul sku zhing 'dir spyan drongs shig /mdo sngags bshad sgrub rgyas pa'i las gyis shig /'jig rten dge legs spel ba'i grogs gyis shig /sa skya'i rje btsun 'phrin las myur sgrub shig /bdag 'khor bcas kyi 'gal rkyen myur sol zhig /nu bo'i nad kun zhi ba'i las gyis shig /mdor na bsam don ma lus 'grub par mdzod/ /bdag gi gang bcol las 'di myur bsgrubs na/ /rtsa rgyud bla ma mi mngon dbyings nas dges/ /dkon mchog yi dam rgya mtsho'i thugs dgongs rdzogs/ /chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi mthu dpal 'bar/ /'phrin las mgon po khyod kyi snyan grags gsal/ /de ltar shis pa'i rten 'brel du ma las/ /thar med 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i yid can la/ /'phral yun phan bde myur stsol gdon mi za/
